highlights.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula não têm agendas públicas nesta quinta-feira e devem se preparar para o debate da Globo, marcado para amanhã à noite.

highlights.title: UN searches for new Secretary-General as Antonio Guterres term comes to an end
highlights.summary: Antonio Guterres's term as UN Secretary-General is coming to an end. The international organisation is looking for his replacement. Leading candidates are struggling to secure the support they need. Details from FRANCE 24's correspondent in New York, Jessica Le Masurier.

highlights.title: Defensoria Pública pede ao STF transporte gratuito no 2º turno
highlights.summary: DPU solicitou uma liminar nacional que obrigue transporte gratuito e sem redução de frota neste domingo (25.out)

highlights.title: Netanyahu orders West Bank closure as attack wounds Israelis before election
highlights.summary: Details by FRANCE 24's correspondent in Jerusalem Noga Tarnopolsky.

highlights.title: Saiba como clubes e atletas se posicionaram entre Lula e Flávio
highlights.summary: Jogadoras do São Paulo e Paulinho apoiam petista; Neymar comenta número "22"; diretorias reafirmam neutralidade

highlights.title: French mayors analyze the political crisis as new protests are expected
highlights.summary: French mayors Emmanuel Gregoire of Paris and Benoit Payan of Marseille have analysed the current political crisis in France and the government's choice to impose curfews in several cities to prevent violence in upcoming protests. This comes in the wake of weekend unrest and riots.
